evo.name: Evo
evo.terms: Gas, insurance, parking and km included. Bills the cheapest of minute, hour and day rates. PVRT C$1.50 from 8 hours. Cars only. One-way within the home zone.

modo_car.name: Modo Plus, Daily Drive car
modo_car.terms: Daytime booking, gas car. Day Tripper applies to whole-day bookings. Round trip from a fixed spot.

modo_car_monthly.name: Modo Monthly, Daily Drive car
modo_car_monthly.terms: Daytime booking, gas car, C$6 a month plan. Day Tripper applies to whole-day bookings. Round trip from a fixed spot.

modo_pickup.name: Modo Plus, Large & Loadable (pickup)
modo_pickup.terms: Daytime booking, gas vehicle. Round trip from a fixed spot.

modo_van.name: Modo Plus, Oversized (Ram ProMaster cargo van)
modo_van.terms: Daytime booking. No Day Tripper rate for Oversized. Set-return bookings only.

modo_van_monthly.name: Modo Monthly, Oversized (Ram ProMaster cargo van)
modo_van_monthly.terms: Daytime booking, C$6 a month plan. No Day Tripper rate for Oversized.

homedepot_small.name: Home Depot, small cargo van or pickup
homedepot_small.terms: National price page, Surrey store not confirmed. Unlimited km. Rounded up to the next published tier. Renter needs own non-owned auto liability insurance.

homedepot_large.name: Home Depot, large cargo van
homedepot_large.terms: National price page, Surrey store not confirmed. Unlimited km. Rounded up to the next published tier.

uhaul_van.name: U-Haul cargo van, in town
uhaul_van.terms: Surrey in-town quote for 3 December 2026, per rental day. C$1 environmental fee. Damage cover extra.

uhaul_10.terms: Surrey in-town quote for 3 December 2026, per rental day. C$1 environmental fee.
